title: In 2024, a US woman got permits for a home; months after she moved in, officials ordered removal
summary_full: In Missouri, a woman confronts the daunting prospect of relocating her manufactured home as city officials acknowledge their blunder in approving her permits. Despite admitting their mistake, her request for a zoning variance was turned down, prompting her to consider legal action following the rejection of her appeal. The unfortunate errors have left her with unexpected costs and hardship.
